name: Gilda Manfredi
bio: Gilda Manfredi is a Research Fellow at the University of Basilicata, and her research focuses on Deep Learning, Computer Graphics, eXtended Reality, and Human-Computer Interaction.

name: Sebastian Hubenschmid
bio: Sebastian is a postdoctoral researcher at Aarhus University, Denmark, where he investigates the use of AI agents for spatial reasoning to explore how data visualizations can be harmoniously embedded in mixed and cross-reality environments.

name: Andrea Ubaldi
bio: Andrea Ubaldi is a psychologist and PhD candidate in Psychology. His research focuses on Artificial Intelligence and multimodal prompting, exploring both their psychological implications and potential applications to enhance human well-being.

name: Lucchas Ribeiro Skreinig
bio: Lucchas Ribeiro Skreinig (Graz University of Technology) works on immersive instruction presentation and XR content authoring tools, investigating and improving the accuracy and scalability of content derived from common instruction representations.

name: Pasquale Cascarano
bio: Pasquale Cascarano is a researcher at the Virtual and Augmented Reality Lab at the University of Bologna, whose research focuses on the intersection of artificial intelligence and extended reality, with applications in both medicine and the creative industries.

name: Claudio Sirocchi
bio: Claudio Sirocchi is a PhD student in Information Engineering at Università Politecnica delle Marche, working on Agentic AI and XR for industrial anomaly detection, Human-in-the-Loop interaction, safety, and usability.
